sarees.title: Midnight Blue Brocade Banarasi Silk Saree
sarees.description: An ode to twilight in the sacred ghats of Varanasi. Woven on traditional pit-looms with genuine tested gold zari and pure mulberry katan silk over 45 days.

images.alt_text: Midnight Blue Brocade Banarasi Full View

sarees.title: Crimson & Antique Gold Korvai Kanjeevaram Pattu
sarees.description: Interlocked using the ancient Korvai technique with solid temple borders and pure silver electroplated in 24k gold. Heirloom weight of 920 grams pure silk.

sarees.title: Emerald Tissue Chanderi with Meenakari Butis
sarees.description: Sheer silk-cotton tissue interwoven with micro-spun gold zari and hand-enamelled floral meenakari motifs. Ethereal, lightweight, and luminous.

sarees.title: Patan Royal Purple Double Ikat Patola Saree
sarees.description: An engineering masterpiece created by the Salvi master weavers of Patan. Warp and weft are tie-dyed individually with botanical pigments before handloom weaving.

sarees.title: Blush Rose Katan Organza with Hand-Cut Zari
sarees.description: Delicate spun sheer organza featuring antique gold cutwork kadwa borders and shimmering rose petal undertones. Perfect for contemporary cocktail receptions.

sarees.title: Ivory & Mustard Handpainted Kalamkari Tussar
sarees.description: Wild kosa tussar silk organically textured with natural river dyes. Illustrating mythological courtly garden motifs with fine bamboo pen detailing.

sarees.title: Maharani Gold Shikargah Brocade Saree
sarees.description: The pinnacle of Varanasi weaving. Intricate hunting expedition tableaux with running motifs of royal deer, swans, and palatial foliage in 24k gold zari.
sarees.work_type: Full Shikargah Hunting Scenes in Real Zari

sarees.title: Rani Pink Kadhwa Jangla Banarasi Pure Silk Saree
sarees.description: A masterpiece created with interlocking floral vines (Jangla) that spread continuously across the fabric without breaks. Heavy ceremonial border and regal sheen.
sarees.work_type: Full Jangla Floral Vines in Gold & Silver
